source_refs.note: 5. Environmental health: a main subheading of 22.1.2 Applications of Biostatistics, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 188-188.

blocks.text: Environmental health (mahol aur sehat) mein biostatistics se jaancha jata hai ke pollution (aaloodgi) aur toxins (zehreele maadde) jaisi mahol ki cheezen insani sehat par kya asar dalti hain. Statistical analysis nuqsan deh exposure pehchanta hai aur aise qawaneen (regulations) aur bachao ke tareeqe banane mein rehnumai karta hai jo logon ko mahol ke khatron se bachayen.
